_about: Public polls to seed the feed of ¿Qué votáis?, written for the app. Inspired by the style of Nintendo's Everybody Votes Channel (everyday habits and tastes, two answers, nothing political, religious or personal), not copied from it. Published a few per week with scripts/seed.py. 'kind' says why each one should work: split (likely close to 50/50), surprise (people will guess the majority wrong), divide (different groups answer differently), classic.
